title.en: Is Diesel 30 the off-grid trailer to open first?
title.zh: 无电网拖泵要先打开柴油30吗？

description.en: Open it when 15 m³/h and 60 m / 180 m are enough. Larger off-grid lines move to Diesel 40 and above. The 17 kW rural pump stays separate.
description.zh: 15 m³/h 和 60 m / 180 m 够用时打开它。更大的无电网管路再上柴油40及以上。17 kW 农村泵仍然分开。

h1.en: Is Diesel 30 the off-grid trailer to open first?
h1.zh: 无电网拖泵要先打开柴油30吗？

directAnswer.en: It is the first trailer row, not the first compact row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 30 at 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m, aggregate 3 cm and below and 2000 kg, for sites without stable grid power. A self-built house inside 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal still starts on the 17 kW rural diesel. Use Diesel 30 when the line has left that compact window and has not yet reached Diesel 40’s 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m.
directAnswer.zh: 它是第一台拖式行，不是第一台紧凑行。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油30印成 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m、骨料 3 cm 及以下、2000 kg，用于电网不便的工地。落在 5–8 m³/h 和水平 30–50 m 里的自建房，仍然从 17 kW 农村柴油泵开始。管路离开紧凑窗口、又还没到柴油40的 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m 时，用柴油30。

heading.zh: 石子的介绍和规格要对照着看

body.en: The introduction pairs 60 m / 180 m with 1 cm aggregate. The specification maximum is 3 cm and below. Both are printed. Xingtai should see the actual stone rather than a choice of the convenient cell.
body.zh: 产品介绍把 60 m / 180 m 和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。规格最大是 3 cm 及以下。两处都印了。应让邢台看到真实石子，而不是挑一个更方便的格子。

heading.en: Electric 30 is not the off-grid substitute
heading.zh: 电动30不是无电网的替代品

body.en: Electric 30 prints 30 kW and fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, which is a similar distance pair at 12–15 m³/h, but it is a grid machine for building placement. No supply for 30 kW means you stay on Diesel 30 or step to another diesel, not that Electric 30 runs on diesel fuel.
body.zh: 电动30印了 30 kW 和细石 60 m / 180 m，距离接近，输送量 12–15 m³/h，但它是建筑浇筑用的电网机器。供不起 30 kW 时，留在柴油30或升到另一台柴油泵，不是让电动30烧柴油。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say the compact 17 kW window was checked and does not fit, if that is true. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果属实，请说明已经核对过 17 kW 紧凑窗口并且对不上。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is 2000 kg the lightest diesel trailer?
question.zh: 2000 kg 是最轻的柴油拖泵吗？

answer.en: Among Diesel 30–120, yes, Diesel 30 prints 2000 kg. The rural diesel at 800 kg and the 4100 at 1300 kg are lighter and are not this trailer.
answer.zh: 在柴油30–120里，柴油30印的是 2000 kg。800 kg 的农村柴油泵和 1300 kg 的 4100 更轻，而且不是这台拖泵。
